messages:
alex_support: Hey @jonathan_pm @sara_ml — ACME reported a regression in semantic search results after yesterday's model sync. They say top-k recall dropped and rerank latency spiked. I pulled some metrics and logs below.

alex_support: Summary:
- Customer environment: hosted API, embeddings+reranker pipeline (embed -> vector search -> neural rerank)
- Rolled model: open-model-v2-quant (deployed 2026-03-03 02:14 UTC)
- Symptom: relevant results demoted in rerank step; p95 rerank latency from ~380ms -> ~920ms for their typical queries
- Observed change in embedding similarity distribution: mean cosine down ~0.07 vs baseline

alex_support: Sample query & top results they shared (stripped PII):
"query: \"renewable energy tax incentives 2025\""
Expected top result id: doc_128 (was rank 1); now doc_128 rank 7 after rerank.
Current top 3 (id : rerank_score):
- doc_452 : 0.87
- doc_301 : 0.85
- doc_219 : 0.82

alex_support: Their local search-only (vector distance) still returns doc_128 in top 3, so embedding retrieval seems okay. Reranker is the step altering final order.

alex_support: Logs from reranker around request-id 01H8Z4K2 (truncated):
```
[2026-03-04T11:22:03Z] request_id=01H8Z4K2 pipeline=rerank model=open-rerank-v1 latency_ms=912 candidate_count=12
[2026-03-04T11:22:03Z] request_id=01H8Z4K2 features=embedding_cos_sim:0.54, query_len:7
[2026-03-04T11:22:03Z] error=none
```

sara_ml: Thanks — this looks like a rerank scoring shift rather than pure retrieval drift. Two immediate hypotheses: 1) reranker model weights changed (accidental rollout), or 2) features from embeddings changed due to quantization drift in open-model-v2-quant. Do we have the reranker model version pinned for this customer?

alex_support: Reranker reported version open-rerank-v1 (same as before). Customer notes the only infra change was the unified model sync that replaced embedding binaries with quantized artifacts.

mike_se: Quick thought — quantized embeddings may alter distribution causing feature scaling mismatch inside reranker if preprocessing assumes fp32 stats. If that's the case, reranker scoring could be skewed. Also the latency jump suggests extra CPU/GPU copies or fallback path. Can we get a p50/p95 for embed and rerank separately for the same traces?

alex_support: p50 embed latency: 45ms -> 48ms (no big change). rerank p50: 340ms -> 410ms. rerank p95: 380ms -> 920ms. Request ids we captured: 01H8Z4K2, 01H8Z8A7, 01H8Z9Q1.

jonathan_pm: This needs product triage and a backlog ticket. Customer says it's degrading their core search feature; they're asking for a fix or rollback. Proposed next steps:
- Create a product ticket (link it in thread)
- Assign to eng-ml to investigate distribution shift + scoring behavior
- Short-term mitigation: pin traffic for this customer to previous embedding artifact or enable reranker fallback to last-known-good scoring weights
- Acceptance criteria suggestion: restore end-to-end recall for their test queries within 5% of baseline AND reduce rerank p95 to <= 400ms for their traffic profile.

alex_support: I've communicated we'll investigate and offered to pin them to previous model while we triage. They accepted temporary pin.

jonathan_pm: I created RI-8421 and added initial notes + logs. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-8421
Acceptance criteria I put in ticket:
- Reproduce failure on internal eval harness using customer's sample set
- Identify root cause (quantization drift vs reranker weight/feature mismatch)
- Implement fix or safe rollback that doesn't regress other customers
- Add a regression test and a metric alert (embedding distribution drift + rerank recall)

sara_ml: Assigning to eng-ml (putting myself on it). Short-term plan: 1) repro on staging with open-model-v2-quant, 2) run ablation: quantized embeddings -> reranker scores, 3) check preprocessing scaling (fp16/uint8), 4) try force-fp32 conversion or rescale features to previous stats.

sara_ml: For rollback/pinning we can use route override:
```yaml
routing_override:
  customer_id: acme-corp
  model: open-model-v1-fp32
  until: 2026-03-11T23:59:00Z
```
I'll coordinate with infra to push that if needed.

mike_se: If we pin, let's ensure we capture a/b traffic and metrics so we can validate fix before unpin. Also add a quick perf opt: disable CPU fallback path that appears in traces.

alex_support: Noted. I told customer we can pin them temporarily and that eng-ml will follow up within 24h. They appreciate quick action.

deploy-bot: Ticket RI-8421 created and assigned to sara_ml. SLA: respond within 24h.

jonathan_pm: OK — marking this P1 for customer-impact tracking but keep team focus on narrow regression triage (not a broad platform incident yet). If we confirm it's quantization causing drift, we should add a rollout guard for future artifact swaps.

sara_ml: Will post updates in this thread as we reproduce. For now, next immediate actions: repro on staging (today), pin customer if repro succeeds, and add a small eval job to run across 10 customers' test sets to detect collateral regressions.

alex_support: Thanks team — I'll update ACME after pin is live and paste any customer feedback here.
